commands.label: versions-and-isolation-path
argv: import sys,sysconfig,importlib.metadata as m,importlib.util; from build.env import _PipBackend; b=_PipBackend(); print(sys.version,sysconfig.get_platform()); print({n:m.version(n) for n in ('build','pip','pdm-backend','packaging','pyproject-hooks')}); print('valid_outer_pip=',b._has_valid_outer_pip,'virtualenv=',b._has_virtualenv,'create_with_virtualenv=',b._create_with_virtualenv); print('ensurepip_used_by_build=',not b._has_valid_outer_pip and not b._create_with_virtualenv)
